title: Scrum Master / Agile Coach
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Scrum Master / Agile Coach: Facilitate agile teams with Scrum, Kanban, ceremonies, coaching, metrics, stakeholder alignment, impediment removal, and continuous improvement.

tree.name: Agile Foundations & Mindset
tree.description: Build a robust understanding of Agile principles, values, and mindsets. Master core frameworks like Scrum and Kanban, and explore foundational tools and concepts essential for any agile practitioner.

resources.title: Agile Scrum Full Course In 4 Hours | Agile Scrum Master Training | Agile Training Video |Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

children.name: Agile Manifesto: Values & Principles
children.description: Dive deep into the Agile Manifesto: its four core values and twelve supporting principles that guide agile approaches to software development and beyond, fostering an adaptive and customer-centric mindset.

children.name: Agile Mindset & Empiricism
children.description: Cultivate the core agile mindset, embracing iterative and incremental development, customer collaboration, and a deep understanding of empiricism – learning from experience and making decisions based on observed facts.

children.name: Scrum Framework Deep Dive
children.description: Master the Scrum framework, understanding its empirical pillars (transparency, inspection, adaptation), roles (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Developers), events (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective), and artifacts (Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Increment).

resources.title: Scrum Master Training: What is Scrum?

children.name: Kanban Method Fundamentals
children.description: Grasp the core principles and practices of the Kanban method: visualizing workflow, limiting Work in Progress (WIP), managing flow, making policies explicit, implementing feedback loops, and improving collaboratively for predictable delivery.

children.name: Lean Thinking for Agile
children.description: Explore Lean principles such as identifying and eliminating waste, empowering the team, delivering value fast, optimizing the whole system, building quality in, and deferring commitment, and how they apply to agile environments.

resources.title: The Principles of Lean Thinking for Agile Development

children.name: Agile Project Management Tools
children.description: Become proficient with popular agile project management tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, Trello, and Asana for effective backlog management, task tracking, visualizing team progress, and creating essential reports.

tree.name: Scrum Master: Coaching & Facilitation
tree.description: Develop the practical skills of a Scrum Master and an emerging Agile Coach, focusing on expert facilitation, effective coaching techniques, conflict resolution, servant leadership, and fostering high-performing teams.

resources.title: Agile Scrum Master Full Course | Agile Training for Beginners | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

children.name: Expert Scrum Event Facilitation
children.description: Master advanced techniques for effectively facilitating all Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective) and other agile meetings, ensuring engagement, psychological safety, focus, and desired outcomes.

resources.title: Top 10 Facilitation Skills for Scrum Masters

children.name: Effective Communication & Active Listening
children.description: Develop strong communication skills, including active listening, powerful questioning, and non-verbal communication, essential for building trust, understanding team needs, and facilitating productive dialogues.

resources.title: Active Listening: The Key to Effective Communication
The Power of Questions in Coaching

children.name: Agile Coaching, Mentoring & Teaching
children.description: Learn the basics of agile coaching, including active listening, powerful questioning, providing effective feedback. Understand and practice different coaching stances (coaching, mentoring, teaching, facilitating) to guide individuals, teams, and Product Owners.

resources.title: The Four Stances of a Scrum Master

children.name: Building High-Performing Teams
children.description: Understand team dynamics using models like Tuckman's stages (forming, storming, norming, performing) and develop strategies for building high-performing, self-managing teams. Foster psychological safety, handle conflicts constructively, and promote collaboration.

resources.title: Dealing with Conflict as a Scrum Master
The 5 Dysfunctions of a Team by Patrick Lencioni (Summary)

children.name: Servant Leadership & Empowerment
children.description: Embrace the mindset of a servant leader, focusing on empowering the team, fostering self-organization, and protecting the team from external interference. Learn to create an environment where the team can thrive and take ownership.

children.name: Proactive Impediment Resolution
children.description: Learn systematic approaches to proactively identify, track, escalate, and resolve impediments that hinder team progress. Develop skills in systemic thinking to address root causes, not just symptoms, ensuring a smooth and efficient workflow.

resources.title: How to Remove Impediments as a Scrum Master

tree.name: Organizational Agility, Metrics & Scaling
tree.description: Expand your influence beyond single teams to foster organizational agility. Master stakeholder management, leverage data through advanced agile metrics, drive continuous improvement at scale, and support Product Owners effectively.

resources.title: Agile and SCRUM Full Course | Agile SCRUM Tutorial | Agile SCRUM Training | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

children.name: Stakeholder Engagement & Management
children.description: Develop advanced skills in identifying key stakeholders, engaging them effectively, managing expectations, fostering transparent communication, and collaboratively managing resistance during agile adoption and transformation efforts.

children.name: Product Owner Support & Coaching
children.description: Learn to effectively support and coach Product Owners in their critical role. This includes backlog refinement, vision articulation, stakeholder collaboration, understanding business value, and navigating product discovery.

resources.title: Scrum Master and Product Owner: The Dynamic Duo

children.name: Agile Metrics & Value Delivery
children.description: Understand and expertly utilize key agile metrics such as Velocity, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Burndown/Burnup charts, and Cumulative Flow Diagrams. Learn to use metrics for informed decision-making, forecasting, and continuous improvement, emphasizing value delivery and avoiding misuse for micromanagement.

children.name: Systemic Continuous Improvement
children.description: Cultivate a culture of continuous learning and adaptation within teams and across the organization. Explore advanced techniques like Systems Thinking, Kaizen events, A3 problem-solving, and establishing robust feedback loops for ongoing process and value stream enhancement.

children.name: Introduction to Scaling Agile Frameworks
children.description: Gain a foundational understanding of popular frameworks for scaling agile beyond a single team, such as SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), LeSS (Large-Scale Scrum), Nexus, and Scrum@Scale. Learn their core principles, common challenges, and potential benefits.

resources.title: What is SAFe? The Scaled Agile Framework Explained

children.name: Value Stream Mapping & Optimization
children.description: Understand and apply Value Stream Mapping (VSM) to identify waste, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization within end-to-end value delivery processes, from ideation to customer delivery.

children.name: Agile Organizational Change Leadership
children.description: Develop the capabilities to lead and guide organizations through agile transformations. Understand change models (e.g., Kotter's 8-Step Change Model, ADKAR), identify patterns of resistance, and devise strategies for fostering sustainable agile adoption at an organizational level.

resources.title: Leading Change: Why Transformation Efforts Fail (John Kotter)
The ADKAR Model for Change Management

tree.name: Advanced Agile Leadership & Professional Growth
tree.description: Elevate your expertise to an advanced agile leadership level. Focus on enterprise-level coaching, fostering organizational learning, ethical practices, building a professional brand, and strategic career positioning.

children.name: Enterprise Agile Coaching Mastery
children.description: Evolve your coaching beyond team-level to become an enterprise-level Agile Coach. Learn to apply systems thinking, coach multiple teams, product leadership, senior management, and executives across various organizational structures.

children.name: Agile Ethics & Professional Conduct
children.description: Understand and adhere to ethical guidelines and professional conduct expectations for agile coaches and Scrum Masters. Address confidentiality, conflict of interest, bias, and the boundaries of your role in organizational settings.

resources.title: ICAgile Agile Coaching Code of Ethics

children.name: Building Agile Communities of Practice
children.description: Design and establish thriving Communities of Practice (CoPs) and Guilds to facilitate knowledge sharing, peer learning, and cross-pollination of agile best practices across departments and organizational boundaries.

resources.title: Communities of Practice: The Secret Sauce for Agile Success

children.name: Agile Storytelling & Impact Showcasing
children.description: Master the art of articulating your experiences, successes, challenges, and lessons learned as a Scrum Master/Agile Coach. Develop compelling narratives for your portfolio, presentations, and interviews that clearly showcase your impact and value delivered.

resources.title: How to Tell Your Story as an Agile Coach

children.name: Capstone Project: Agile Transformation Leadership
children.description: Undertake a comprehensive project simulating an agile transformation within an organization. Apply all learned principles, frameworks, and coaching techniques to identify challenges, design solutions, guide teams, and measure impact. Document the journey, including a detailed retrospective and lessons learned.

children.name: Personal Branding & Thought Leadership
children.description: Develop your personal brand as an Agile leader. Learn to share insights, contribute to the agile community through blogs, presentations, or meetups, and establish yourself as a thought leader in the agile space.

resources.title: How to Build Your Personal Brand as an Agile Coach

children.name: Professional Certifications & Pathways
children.description: Explore various professional certifications for Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches (e.g., PSM, CSM, SAFe, KMP, ICP-ACC). Understand their value, preparation strategies, and how they align with career progression.

resources.title: Which Scrum Master Certification Should I Get?

children.name: Career Advancement & Interview Strategies
children.description: Prepare comprehensively for advanced Scrum Master and Agile Coach roles. Understand common behavioral and technical interview questions, craft compelling answers, and effectively position your skills, experience, and leadership potential to secure desired roles.

resources.title: Scrum Master Interview Questions and Answers
